title: Rex Financial亚洲主管：亚洲客户占比飙至23%，在线交易如何改变资管格局？
speaker: Head of Asia at Rex Financial

segments.en: Let's talk about your investor mix. The Asians have jumped up quite a bit. 11% a year or so ago to 20 to 23%. So almost one in five or almost one in four of your assets under management are held by Asian investors. What's behind that and how do you see that growing?
segments.zh: 我们来谈谈投资者结构。亚洲客户占比大幅上升，一年前约11%，现在到20%到23%。也就是说，几乎五分之一到四分之一的资管规模由亚洲投资者持有。背后原因是什么？你如何看待增长？

segments.en: I think behind that is the huge amount of adoption for the online trading community. The Korea has been providing maybe over 10 plus years of the online trading. Hong Kong has been around five or six years based on observation. Japan has been just around two to three years of time. And those are the three to biggest holders in Asia.
segments.zh: 我认为背后是线上交易社区的大规模普及。韩国提供线上交易可能超过10年，香港根据观察大约五六年，日本大约两三年。这三个是亚洲最大的持有者。

segments.en: Yes. Koreans, then Hong Kong, then Japan. Yes, it's true. At the same time, the Nasdaq and NOSC is about to open in 23-5-hour trading, starting from December.
segments.zh: 是的，韩国、香港、日本。没错。同时，纳斯达克和NOSC即将从12月开始提供23小时交易。

segments.en: That could be also another on the investor flop into the trading US listed, and the ETF because they can even trading there at the daytime hours.
segments.zh: 这可能也会推动投资者流入美国上市产品和ETF，因为他们甚至可以在白天时段交易。

segments.en: Recently, what have been the most popular things? For among the investors, among everything that you oversee. It seems to be the most popular. I haven't heard about this. What is this? Yes. Oh, okay. New terminology. Sure. I think AI is still there.
segments.zh: 最近最受欢迎的是什么？在投资者中，在你管理的所有产品中，似乎最受欢迎。我没听过这个。这是什么？是的。哦，好的。新术语。当然。我认为AI仍然在。

segments.en: It was there for 12 months ago, six months ago, even right now. But it's about the, how do you want to trading that? Like you want to trading for the online thematic, or the even leverage product, or the option-based income strategy.
segments.zh: 12个月前、6个月前，甚至现在都在。但关键是你想怎么交易？是想交易线上主题，还是杠杆产品，还是期权收益策略。
